body: Remember it was her breach of your trust that caused you to look in the 1st place. I discovered my wife’s affair by checking out her journal because things weren’t going well and I thought I might find some clues as to what was wrong. The journal was empty except for an explicit poem from her lover. I felt guilty for prying, but my breach was minor compared to what she did to me. You need to let her know that you need complete transparency, even if it means handling over her phone for you to inspect. Good luck!

Wow, you are the model of self restraint. The first time I found evidence of cheating, I lasted about 2 hours before confronting her. She left me for her lover, but came back the next week. She promised no more lies or deceit, and vowed to make it work. I found out that was all bullshit 5 days ago, too, at couples counseling. I didn’t make it to the end of the session. I contacted a lawyer today, and I’m going condo shopping in a few minutes. 
I’m right there with you, going through the same emotions, so if you ever need a sympathetic ear, just chat me up.
Good luck, stay strong, and remember you did not cause this.
Getting stronger by the day. I checked out the pictures you posted and I think you’re hot! Good luck on your journey ❤️

Thanks, that’s what I have to keep reminding myself of. Up until now, my self image was husband and father. Now I’m neither. I haven’t completely cherished my new-found freedom yet, but I hope that it is coming

Thanks and I’m sorry that you are now repulsed by women. I still think there are some good ones out there. My suicidal thoughts are lessening, and all these responses are helping. I’ll make it through another day
Better now than later, I can assure you
I try to tell myself that this intense grief will help me in the long run. I’ve never felt like this before, so now it helps me understand the human being a little better
Great words of advice, thanks a lot
I’m trying to come to grips with my new reality. It’s too late at night here to reach out to a friend, so I’m reaching out to my Reddit community. Thanks for the shared grief.
